note: descriptive reconciliation; no condition is compared with an outcome

detector.jump: max one-day close-to-close gain over the last EXPLOSION_LOOKBACK=5 sessions >= EXPLOSION_PCT=50
detector.run: Super_stock._run_explosion: largest trough-to-later-close rise within the last EXPLOSION_RUN_LOOKBACK=20 sessions >= EXPLOSION_RUN_PCT=70
detector.L: launch = session after the trough close; moved earlier when a later detection of the same move reveals an earlier trough (never before the previous episode's peak)
detector.D1: first session the detector fires for the episode (observable that day)
detector.x70: first close >= 1.70 × the trough close (retrospective: needs L)
detector.IGN: largest one-day close gain in [L, D1]
detector.quality: SPLIT_NEAR if any split is dated in [L − 5 days, D1 + 1 day]
detector.note: a jump episode qualifies at +50% close-to-close; x70 may be later or absent

not_archived_for_any_date: the app's own condition states (except the dated screenshots in audit/chip_parity.json)
